easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Activate Words of War by paying {1}.
Attempt to draw a card. The draw will be replaced by Words of War targeting Morselhoarder. The 2 damage will instead place two -1/-1 counters on Morselhoarder due to Everlasting Torment.
Auntie Ool triggers. Holding priority, activate Morselhoarder twice by removing two -1/-1 counters from it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Words of War by paying {1}.
Resolve the Auntie Ool trigger, attempting to draw a card. The draw will be replaced by Words of War targeting Morselhoarder. The 2 damage will instead place two -1/-1 counters on Morselhoarder due to Everlasting Torment.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.name: Morselhoarder
uses.cardState: with no more than one -1/-1 counter on it
